subject: Annotation throughput - Video AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

My colleague was in touch with Chris Hall and it sounded like increasing labelling throughput + more comprehensive modality support for VLM (syncing video, audio & text) were potential areas of improvement for [COMPANY]. So I wanted to introduce myself as your point of contact at Encord - a unified data development platform for curation, annotation & dataset evaluation for video AI teams.
